purpose: Map patent claim families to implementation mechanisms, experimental evidence, and remaining validation gaps.
scope_boundary: This is a patent-writing traceability artifact. It does not add new benchmark results.

claim_families.draft_claim_language: A table reasoning method that estimates sample risk from question semantics, table structure, answer contract, and execution signals, then selectively routes the sample to lightweight execution, deterministic audit, or stronger verification/collaboration.

experimental_trace.evidence: Full200 aggregate MyAgent 489/600 vs MACT 450/600; token ratio 0.5717; elapsed ratio 0.1337; failures/missing 0/0.
Mechanism matrix ties full200 performance to risk collaboration and budget control.
E3 max_replan=5 probe recovered 4/12 representative wrong rows with failures/missing 0/0, showing budget sensitivity for selected categories but not E3 stability closure.
E3 semantic-boundary plan separates budget-sensitive categories from zero-recovery semantic-guard categories and blocks full reruns until targeted guards pass affected-slice validation.
E3 S2 after-guard fresh passed the affected-slice gate: 8/12 representative wrong rows recovered, 18/18 no-harm rows retained, failures/missing 0/0, weighted token ratio 0.6104.

E3 S3 after-guard current-only rerun completed with combined 215/300, weighted token ratio 0.5866, failures/missing 0/0. Seed-C passed, but Seed-D missed WTQ/TabFact gates, so paired MACT was not started.

claim_families.remaining_gap: E3 Seed-C/Seed-D current-only boundary evidence, budget probe, semantic-boundary plan, S2 after-guard fresh, and S3 current-only rerun are complete, but S3 still leaves Seed-D WTQ/TabFact below gate. Multi-model execution remains needed before making broad model-externality claims.

claim_families.draft_claim_language: A compression method that preserves global rows, candidate rows, late-column evidence, and neighbor rows when the question contains comparative, temporal, ordinal, count, or entity-disambiguation risk signals.

experimental_trace.evidence: WTQ gain rows 16/25 tagged evidence_retention; TabFact gain rows 9/9 tagged evidence_retention; CRT current-only vs MACT 37/40 tagged evidence_retention.
WTQ P4b diagnosis separates compression/evidence issues from answer-contract and semantic shortcut issues.

claim_families.remaining_gap: Fine-grained no_evidence_retention ablation would strengthen causal proof if requested by patent counsel.

claim_families.draft_claim_language: A deterministic audit layer that directly validates table-consistency patterns such as same-row constraints, column-value counts, entity attributes, numeric differences, temporal gaps, overtime markers, listed-after target columns, and ordinal/cardinal phrase matching.

experimental_trace.evidence: no_deterministic_shortcuts drops overall by 15/150; TabFact by 9/50; CRT by 7/50; TabFact token/current becomes 1.4487x.
TabFact full200 MyAgent 194/200 vs MACT 189/200 with token ratio 0.2014.
P0 semantic-guard backlog identifies CRT numeric composition, CRT span/universal quantifier, WTQ entity lookup, and TabFact false-negative entailment as zero-recovery categories after budget probe.
After implementing gold-free semantic guards, S2 fresh validation recovered 8/12 representative wrong rows while preserving all 18 no-harm rows.
S3 after-guard current-only rerun shows the semantic guards transfer to Seed-C, but Seed-D WTQ/TabFact remain boundary categories.

claim_families.remaining_gap: WTQ targeted fresh, P4b after-targeted validation, E3 S2 after-guard validation, and S3 current-only rerun are complete. Seed-D WTQ/TabFact remain below gate, so optional fine-grained deterministic-audit or boundary diagnosis should focus there.

claim_families.draft_claim_language: A conflict-resolution method that accepts a verifier or reviewer candidate only when confidence, answer contract, table evidence, and conflict type satisfy bounded override criteria.

experimental_trace.evidence: no_strong_verification is 8/150 below current reference and WTQ is 7/50 below current reference on diagnostic slice.
WTQ 24/25 gain rows tagged strong_verification.
WTQ P4b offline projection 37/50 -> 46/50 with 9 wrong-to-correct and 0 projected harm.
WTQ affected-slice fresh validation completed at 9/9 with merged/eval 9/9 and failures/missing 0/0.
After-targeted P4b Gate-50 completed with MyAgent 121/150 vs MACT 111/150, all three datasets above MACT, token ratio 0.5310, failures/missing 0/0.
The next controlled-override work should follow the P0/P1 guard ladder before any new E3 paired MACT runtime.
The P0/P1 guard ladder passed S2 affected-slice fresh validation with decision after_guard_passes_s2_gate.
S3 after-guard current-only rerun passed Seed-C but stopped on Seed-D WTQ/TabFact; this supports bounded funnel control rather than starting paired MACT prematurely.

claim_families.remaining_gap: No immediate WTQ fresh or S2 affected-slice gap remains. S3 current-only has run; future work should diagnose Seed-D WTQ/TabFact before broader seed stability or paired MACT claims.

claim_families.draft_claim_language: An answer contract module that constrains final outputs to scalar, label, entity, tuple, or list shapes and rejects or rewrites answers whose surface form does not match the requested denotation.

experimental_trace.evidence: Full200 MyAgent failures/missing 0/0 across WTQ, TabFact, and CRT.
Diagnosis includes myAgent-only rows where concise denotation succeeds while MACT explanatory answers fail strict WTQ matching.

claim_families.remaining_gap: No immediate gap; continue recording failures/missing in every future seed/model run.

claim_families.draft_claim_language: A validation and deployment funnel that applies Gate-10, Gate-50, Gate-150, and paired-200 stages to avoid spending full experimental cost on models or seeds that fail early reliability, accuracy, or token criteria.

experimental_trace.evidence: Historical non-main local models recorded as no-go rather than expanded to paired-200.
Seed-C/Seed-D prepared with non-overlapping inputs and current-only-before-paired execution rule.

Seed-C and Seed-D current-only runs completed with 300 merged rows, 212/300 correct, weighted token ratio 0.5916, failures/missing 0/0, and row-level verification pass; both stopped before paired MACT under the gate rule.
E3 max_replan=5 probe recovered 4/12 representative wrong rows; WTQ recovered 1/4, TabFact 3/4, CRT 0/4. Decision is mixed_budget_sensitivity_not_enough_for_e3_stability.
Decision do_not_rerun_full200_or_paired_mact_until_targeted_guards_pass; ladder is S1 design/unit, S2 affected-slice fresh, S3 E3 current-only rerun, S4 paired MACT or boundary closeout.
S2 affected-slice/no-harm fresh validation passed, so the next budget-aware funnel stage is S3 Seed-C/D current-only rerun before any paired MACT runtime.
S3 current-only after-guard completed: Seed-C 118/150 pass, Seed-D 97/150 inspect, combined 215/300, weighted token ratio 0.5866, failures/missing 0/0, decision s3_stop_or_inspect_boundary_remains.

claim_families.remaining_gap: Need at least one new viable model/API candidate for E4. Seed-C/Seed-D current-only execution, budget probe, semantic-boundary plan, S2 after-guard fresh, and S3 rerun are complete but remain boundary/mechanism evidence because Seed-D WTQ/TabFact missed S3 gates.

requires_future_evidence_before_broad_cl: At least one viable additional model/API gate result

Additional seed stability evidence only after Seed-D WTQ/TabFact boundary diagnosis and a new S3 pass, or if the boundary is accepted under a narrower claim scope; the current max_replan=5 probe supports adaptive budgeting for selected categories but not blanket budget expansion
